title: RibaMod versus direct-BMI current-boundary infiltration-to-allocation visibility
purpose: Localize why a physically active ~8 m3/day River infiltration did not change the t=0 allocation in DUMMY-20H by separating actual-RibaMod pointer timing from direct Ribasim BMI pointer-to-allocation visibility.

routes.direct_control: Fresh RibasimWrapper v2026.1.1, leave basin.infiltration at zero, call update_until(6h), finalize, read allocation.nc.
routes.direct_injection: Fresh identical RibasimWrapper, write 7.999914667576883 m3/day into get_value_ptr('basin.infiltration') before first update_until(6h), verify readback, advance, finalize, read allocation.nc.
routes.actual_ribamod: Actual active-River RibaMod case. Wrap only RibasimWrapper.update_until for read-only observation of basin.infiltration immediately before the real driver calls it; do not change product ordering or state.

frozen_assertions: Direct control t=0 allocation is 32/0 m3/day.
Actual RibaMod pre-update_until infiltration pointer equals the first active-River flux within 0.01 m3/day.
Actual RibaMod t=0 allocation reproduces the admitted DUMMY-20H value 32/0 m3/day.
Direct-injection pointer readback equals the injected rate before update_until.
Direct-injection physical cumulative infiltration after 6h is materially positive, proving the pointer is physically effective.
All three routes use the exact bundled Ribasim v2026.1.1 binary.

preregistered_decision_matrix.interpretation: The same writable vertical-flux pointer affects physical realization but not the current fixed-grid UserDemand allocation decision in v2026.1.1. RibaMod is transparent to that release behavior.

preregistered_decision_matrix.condition: direct_injection allocation root ~= 24.0000853 and external ~= 0, while actual RibaMod remains 32/0 with pre-update pointer ~= 8
preregistered_decision_matrix.interpretation: Direct Ribasim can consume the BMI-set forcing for current allocation, but the actual RibaMod composition introduces an additional timing/state seam.

preregistered_decision_matrix.condition: actual RibaMod pre-update pointer is not ~= 8
preregistered_decision_matrix.interpretation: The physical exchange is visible after the step but was not present in the Ribasim infiltration pointer at the allocation call boundary.
Do not infer ownership; preregister a narrower follow-up.

forbidden: no modification of upstream iMOD Coupler or Ribasim source
no manual reconstruction of RibaMod.update as authority
the read-only update_until wrapper may observe pointer state but must delegate unchanged to the original method
no post-output retuning of classification thresholds
